name: port-design-system-from-local-clone
description: Autonomous visual porting skill v3.0. Clones the complete design system from any public URL into a Next.js target. Extracts tokens, animations, 3D scenes, assets, interactions, dark mode, and responsive behavior via MCP browser. 7 extraction scripts, multi-viewport QA (375/768/1440px), scroll narrative generation, checkpoint system. Single command, zero manual input. Complete when pixel delta <= 1.5% at all scroll positions across all viewports.
